policy.device_ready_requires: emulator_ready plus every physical_required scenario on the exact firmware SHA
policy.bluetooth_scope: protocol, bounds, replay, resume, sealed-pack staging and atomic commit are modeled; radio, GATT timing and Android interoperability are physical-only

scenarios.claim: Eight firmware menu destinations are present in firmware order
Continue Reading resumes the retained recent document
Physical button navigation wraps and routes without touch assumptions
Root and nested directory listings filter to supported book/image extensions
Hidden entries obey setting and System Volume Information remains hidden
EPUB XTC TXT Markdown and BMP route to the correct viewer
Short Back navigates to parent and long Back returns to root
Long Confirm asks before file or recursive directory deletion
Delete cancellation changes nothing and delete failure is not reported as success
Missing files are pruned before display or open
Confirm opens an existing recent item
Long Confirm removal changes recents only, not the book
Synthetic UTF-8 TXT indexes into multiple pages with monotonic offsets
CRLF split boundaries remain one logical terminator
Embedded NUL and malformed UTF-8 fail closed
Page progress restores within range and reports 0..10000 basis points
Progress writes use a temporary file and never promote a short write
Synthetic multi-spine EPUB crosses pages and spine boundaries
Current Today EPUB has exactly one spine document
Today single spine contains enough content to paginate beyond one X3 page
Saved spine equal to or beyond spine count resets to page one
End of book is in-session and Back returns to the final page
Managed Inbox artifacts never expose hash filenames as sibling suggestions
Malformed, oversized and allocation-starved EPUB paths obey safety bounds
Ordinary open renders cache before any modeled network session
One automatic attempt is claimed per Brisbane day
Manual refresh bypasses same-day suppression
Freshness is stamped only after complete V1 and V2 success
HTTP not-modified preserves verified cache
No Wi-Fi, clock, malformed payload, network and storage errors are distinct
Opening a full report uses the TXT reader and returns to Cards
Scheduled transient retries are bounded and diagnostic wakes never retry
A partial fixed-slot manifest is rejected before it can prune a valid cached card
Modeled sync downloads paged artifact and metadata changes
Eight changes per page and ten pages per wake are hard bounds
All 64 local items paginate with stable timestamp and item-id ordering
Cards-style digest shows summary and key points before open
Text EPUB image action and sleep-screen artifact kinds route safely
Artifact hash and declared byte count are verified before commit
Cursor advances only over a committed prefix
Receipt failure cannot block opening a verified local artifact
Delete removes locally even when cloud receipt cannot be queued and reports that state
Missing artifact says File missing - sync again
Interrupted sync retries from durable cursor without losing earlier items
Same-day complete cursor-matched first page can use the fast index
Ten-page exhaustion reports catch-up pending and over-capacity recovery keeps the newest 64 visible
Canonical sleep.bmp is exact 528x792 four-gray 4-bpp and 209158 bytes
Tone, edge detail, gutters and periodic-grid scores pass against uncropped master
Power hold enters sleep and modeled wake returns to prior surface
Dedicated sleep refresh uses the maximum hardware-validated one condition pass and no unvalidated duplicate FULL loop
Panel waveform, ghosting and final E-Ink appearance pass on physical X3
Emulator session is isolated and cannot write workspace or physical device
Virtual path traversal, malformed escaping and protected paths fail closed
PUT uses temp and backup promotion; incomplete upload retains prior destination
Move copy delete and directory error paths preserve explicit status
Upload and download buffers service watchdog in long loops
Real microSD write, eject, brownout and power-loss behavior passes physically
Settings surface exposes system reader display and network controls
Daily Wake Status reports request, credential readiness, last result and next wake
Firmware picker shows only bin files and supports cancellation
Resource panel reports firmware SHA, size, headroom and hard/warning status
Brisbane midnight changes the durable local day exactly once
Primary, 08:15 catch-up and 18:00 catch-up windows choose the next future time
Duplicate wake windows collapse
Invalid RTC fails closed before TLS sync
RTC timer, deep-sleep current and wake reason pass on the exact physical X3
Battery percentage and status-bar visibility render from synthetic values
ADC calibration, discharge behavior and brownout pass on physical hardware
Crash screen consumes sanitized retained fields and clears panic state
Raw stack, retained logs and secret-bearing abort text are never persisted
Real panic, reboot and SD crash_report.txt behavior passes on exact firmware
Protocol bounds pin 64KiB manifest, 68 objects, 20MiB object and 64MiB pack
CRC, stream, offset and chunk sequencing fail closed
Four-chunk windows checkpoint and valid resume state is preserved
Replay-safe pack ID, enrollment identity and control ownership rules are enforced
Manifest and object hashes must validate before sealed-pack commit
Interrupted commit rolls back without partial V1/V2 publication
Pocket Sync UI exposes bounded synthetic staging status
BLE radio, bonding, MTU, GATT timing and Android interoperability pass physically
START before QUERY, duplicate control work, out-of-order transitions and ABORT follow the firmware state machine
Corrupt or orphaned resume sidecars reset while a valid checkpoint resumes exactly
Receipt history, durable cursor and completed pack identity make replay idempotent
Power loss during commit recovers the journal; ordinary validation or receipt failure rolls back without publication
Machine-readable resource source gate and checker self-test pass
Canonical BIN, MAP and effective sdkconfig pass linked limits
Canonical update is a valid ESP32-C3 image with SHA and embedded build ID
Network, JSON, file, display and Pocket buffers remain within the contract
ESP32-C3 ROM, bootloader and application entry pass offline QEMU
Peak heap, largest block, task high-water and watchdog timing pass physically
Wi-Fi TLS, DNS, NTP and live Worker interoperability pass on exact firmware
